cassia.predicted_cell_type: CD4+ T cell, with a memory/activated phenotype
strengths: Correctly recognizes T cell lineage from CD2, CD3D, CD3E, LCK, LAT.
Captures the activation-associated signature (FOS, JUNB, DUSP1, ZFP36).
weaknesses: CD4+ identity is not supported by any CD4 marker in the ORIGINAL DEGs.
Memory/activated phenotype is over-specified relative to available evidence.

strengths: Conservative T cell anchor is directly supported by canonical markers CD2, CD3D, CD3E, LCK, LAT, IL7R, IL2RG, SIT1, LTB.
Avoids unsupported CD4/CD8 and memory-state claims.
weaknesses: Stops at the T cell level; the enrichment term 'alpha-beta T cell activation' permits a supported hierarchical refinement to alpha-beta T cell.

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: stem cell memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
strengths: Correctly notes absence of CD8 and cytotoxic markers (GZMB, PRF1, GNLY, NKG7).
Recognizes the T cell lineage signal in the marker list.
weaknesses: Stem cell memory and CD4+ components are not directly supported by ORIGINAL DEGs.
No CCR7, CD4, CD8, or stem cell memory markers are present to justify the over-specified label.

supporting: T cell identity from ORIGINAL markers: CD2, CD3D, CD3E, LCK, LAT, IL7R, IL2RG, SIT1, LTB.
Alpha-beta refinement supported by ORIGINAL enrichment terms 'alpha-beta T cell activation' and 'regulation of alpha-beta T cell activation' (PMID 33932031 as associated T cell literature).
Activation-associated genes FOS, JUNB, DUSP1, ZFP36, PKM, DDIT4 explain the transient activation/metabolic state but do not change lineage.
conflicting: No CD4, CD8A, CD8B, CCR7, SELL, FOXP3, or cytotoxic markers in the DEG list
CD4 vs CD8 and memory-state refinement are unsupported.
The GO term 'regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell activation' alone is insufficient to choose the CD4 branch because no CD4 marker is observed.
enrichment_or_literature: GO terms: regulation of T cell activation, T cell differentiation, alpha-beta T cell activation, TCR signaling.
PMID 33932031 included as allowed supporting literature for T cell identity.
